decisions.reason: As a flagship service that directly extends the firm's core cloud messaging capabilities, it fits existing knowledge and R&D well, so management is likely to keep refining rather than withdraw it.
This service builds on adjacent document workflow competences and showed a concrete customer reference, which gives the firm usable feedback it can absorb and improve upon.

Email and fax conversion is closely related to the firm's established multichannel communications base, so despite being less prominently positioned it is still likely worth retaining as a complementary offer.

The fax delivery optimization feature is highly related to existing fax and delivery operations, but as a narrow feature with limited visible prominence it faces a somewhat higher bundling or discontinuation risk.
Threat protection complements the firm's secure messaging positioning and can benefit from its technical teams and R&D, making continued commercialization more likely than exit.
